cases.condition: The declared repository, full revision, canonical path, and blob match an available Git object.
cases.expected: Read the canonical rule from the same immutable snapshot.

cases.condition: The source revision is abbreviated, malformed, or not a commit object.
cases.expected: Stop as blocked; do not use a branch, latest, or local fallback.

cases.condition: The declared blob identity differs from the blob at revision:path.
The immutable commit does not contain the canonical path.
The consumer worktree contains a same-named rule with different bytes.
cases.expected: Resolve the rule from the pinned source snapshot, never the consumer path.

cases.condition: The landing shim, landing Skill, and shared gate are all loaded.
cases.expected: The landing Skill invokes only the shared gate and never itself or the shim.

cases.condition: A lower PR and a dependent upper PR are ready in one authority.
cases.expected: Use merge commits bottom-up and preserve the upper head while retargeting its base.

cases.condition: The head/tree is unchanged but the effective base or workflow changes.
cases.expected: Re-evaluate affected evidence; do not assume all evidence is reusable.

cases.condition: A runtime-changing lower member is followed by a docs-only member and an intermediate run is cancelled.
cases.expected: Retain runtime coverage in the cumulative final qualification.

cases.condition: The final tip is green while a lower prefix was not accepted.
cases.expected: Do not accept the lower member from the tip result.

cases.condition: Implementation and validation finish without merge authorization.
cases.expected: Hand off without merge, auto-merge, or review evidence substitution.

cases.condition: Execution resumes after a member landing or review request may already have succeeded.
cases.expected: Refresh live state and do not duplicate the external action.
